user.title: Import a recipe
user.description: Paste the link to a recipe, for example from Chefkoch, Lecker or Allrecipes. Pages that publish schema.org recipe data work as well.

data_description.url: Full web address of the recipe page.

error.cannot_connect: The page could not be loaded. Check the URL and your internet connection.
error.invalid_url: This is not a valid web address.
error.no_recipe: No recipe was found on this page.
error.invalid_response: The page returned data that could not be read.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while importing the recipe.

abort.already_configured: This recipe has already been added.

init.title: Recipe refresh
init.description: How often the recipe should be reloaded from its source page.

data_description.update_interval_hours: 0 disables automatic refresh. The imported recipe stays available from the local cache.

add_to_shopping_list.name: Add ingredients to shopping list
add_to_shopping_list.description: Adds every ingredient of the selected recipe to the Home Assistant shopping list.
